what: Strict `*-vote-output.txt` tool derivation conflicts with documented and tested voter paths
scenario_or_breakage: Main-agent re-tally uses `voter-main-agent.txt`; harnesses use `v1.txt`/`v4.txt` etc. Hard-fail or mis-slot naming breaks SKILL Step 3 and CI unless every caller renames files.
suggested_fix: Exempt `voter-main-agent.txt` (define vN mapping), relax strictness for non-panel files, or explicitly list SKILL + all tally harnesses to rename to `claude-vote-output.txt`/`codex-vote-output.txt`/`cursor-vote-output.txt` and update SKILL instructions.

what: Default `plan-review/round-1/findings-classification.tsv` parent dirs not created by current tally
scenario_or_breakage: mkdir only hits `$DESIGN_TMPDIR`; default nested path write fails for direct/harness tally unless callers pre-create dirs.
suggested_fix: Add `mkdir -p` for the default output dirname inside `tally-plan-review.sh` (and keep loop-side `mkdir -p` for explicit `--findings-classification-out`).

what: Plan edits multiple `.sh` primaries without listing sibling `.md` contract updates
scenario_or_breakage: Repo rule requires sibling docs in same PR for `tally-plan-review.sh`, `render-voter-prompt.sh`, `lib-voter-parse-rate.sh`, `design-log-publish.sh`.
suggested_fix: Omitting updates drifts authoritative contracts and can fail doc lint expectations; add `tally-plan-review.md`, `render-voter-prompt.md`, `lib-voter-parse-rate.md`, `design-log-publish.md` to the change list.

what: Retry prose line reference points at `LARCH_VPR_RETRY_PREFIX_KIND` handler instead of the prefix string constants
scenario_or_breakage: Implementers grep line ~186 and miss the real `VOTER_PARSE_RATE_RETRY_PREFIX_*` bodies at file top.
suggested_fix: Cite lines 10-12 (or variable names) as the edit site for plan/code retry strings.

scenario_or_breakage: Need a deterministic rule mirroring `render-cache/` prefix checks so reviewers implement consistent rejection of stray files.
suggested_fix: Spell out enumerate-and-validate steps (e.g. `find` under `plan-review` then require each file path match `plan-review/round-[0-9]+/findings-classification\\.tsv$` else `larch_err` + fail publish).

what: `voting_result` wording says main-agent disposition while tally uses `classify_result` labels
scenario_or_breakage: Readers may emit `main-agent-vote-required` into the TSV instead of the `rejected` label `classify_result` uses for `eligible<=0`.
suggested_fix: State explicitly that `voting_result` must equal `classify_result` output (zero votes, same `eligible_count`) not the `TALLY_PLAN_REVIEW_STATUS` string.

what: Parser multi-line / duplicate-ID semantics not pinned
scenario_or_breakage: `vote_for_id` last matching line wins; divergent parser choice would desync `v*_vote` from `voting_result`.
suggested_fix: Document and test last-line-wins parity for repeated IDs in one voter file.

what: Zero-finding loop short-circuit skips tally entirely
scenario_or_breakage: `findings-classification.tsv` never materializes on `skipped-empty-findings` unlike rounds that run `tally-plan-review.sh`.
suggested_fix: If analytics need uniform artifacts, track a follow-up to emit header-only TSV from the loop or document the exception.
